name: Custom Shape Interchangeable Pennant Flag Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from a combination of wood, acrylic, disc magnets, and decorative ribbons, creating a layered and interchangeable pennant-style display.
    - Each layer is made from 3mm thick material, offering a sturdy structure while keeping the sign lightweight enough for hanging and seasonal display.
    - Features strong disc magnets for easy attachment and replacement of interchangeable pieces.
    - Decorated with a 4-ribbon combo, including 3 fixed colors (White, Black, and Plaid) and 1 customizable ribbon in your chosen color.
    - Available material options:
          +) Wood and WA:
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 1: Wooden 3mm, 2-sided printing
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 2: Wooden 3mm, 1-sided printing
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 3: Wooden 3mm, 1-sided printing
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 4: Acrylic 3mm, 1-sided printing
                  -> Interchangeable Piece 1 – 2-layer, each wooden layer is 3mm thick, 2-sided printing
                  -> Interchangeable Piece 2– 2-layer, each wooden layer is 3mm thick, 2-sided printing
          +) Wood and AW:
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 1: Wooden 3mm, 2-sided printing
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 2: Wooden 3mm, 1-sided printing
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 3: Acrylic 3mm, 1-sided printing
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 4: Wooden 3mm, 1-sided printing
                  -> Interchangeable Piece 1 – 2-layer, each wooden layer is 3mm thick, 2-sided printing
                  -> Interchangeable Piece 2– 2-layer, each wooden layer is 3mm thick, 2-sided printing
          +) Wood and Acrylic:
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 1: Wooden 3mm, 2-sided printing
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 2: Wooden 3mm, 1-sided printing
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 3: Acrylic 3mm, 1-sided printing
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 4: Acrylic 3mm, 1-sided printing
                  -> Interchangeable Piece 1 – 2-layer, each wooden layer is 3mm thick, 2-sided printing
                  -> Interchangeable Piece 2– 2-layer, each wooden layer is 3mm thick, 2-sided printing
          +) Full Wood:
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 1: Wooden 3mm, 2-sided printing
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 2: Wooden 3mm, 1-sided printing
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 3: Wooden 3mm, 1-sided printing
                  -> Flag Sign – Layer 4: Wooden 3mm, 1-sided printing
                  -> Interchangeable Piece 1 – 2-layer, each wooden layer is 3mm thick, 2-sided printing
                  -> Interchangeable Piece 2– 2-layer, each wooden layer is 3mm thick, 2-sided printing

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm
    - Disc magnets:
          +) Diameter: 1 cm
          +) Thickness: 3mm
          +) Maximum: 3 pairs
    - Ribbon length: 40 cm ~ 15.75 in
    - Ribbon widths:
          +) White and Black ribbon colors: 1.5 cm ~ 0.59 in
          +) Plaid and optional ribbon colors: 1 cm ~ 0.39 in
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for sharp detail, vibrant color, and a long-lasting decorative surface.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative pennant flag sign and a reusable interchangeable keepsake display.
    - Suitable for first day of school signs, classroom décor, holiday decorations, milestone photography, nursery styling, and seasonal home accents.
    - Great for hanging on doors, walls, hooks, gallery corners, shelves, or party backdrops.
    - Easy to update with different interchangeable pieces for new events or themes.
    - Lightweight, charming, and designed for repeated use.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for teachers, students, parents, families, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for back-to-school, birthdays, baby milestones, holidays, classroom decoration, and seasonal celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves reusable personalized décor with interchangeable styling.
    - Great for milestone photo props, school memory signs, and decorative seasonal displays.
    - A creative gift choice that combines personalization, function, and festive charm 🎀🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Interchangeable Pennant Flag Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
